operations.name: debug.surface_dump
operations.description: DEV-ONLY. Dump our full UI surface tree (menubar, tools/subtools, options-bar controls per tool, canvas/layer-row context menus, panel menus) in a manifest node schema (id/kind/label/shortcut/enabled/hidden/children), evaluated against the CURRENT staged document/tool state. Each section carries a `coverage` note describing how completely it was enumerated — some sections (panel menus, some context menus) are imperative and only partially reachable. Used by the parity-sweep loop; stage state via other ops first, then call this.
